introHtml: ML Kishigo is a leading brand in high-visibility safety apparel, trusted by construction crews, roadside workers, and emergency responders. When you order custom ML Kishigo apparel from Perfect Imprints, you get ANSI/ISEA-compliant vests, jackets, and shirts that keep your team safe while featuring your company logo. Choose from multiple colors, reflective tape options, and pocket configurations to match your specific job site requirements. Ideal for companies prioritizing worker safety and brand visibility.
